blocks.text: Enzymes teen-dimensional (three-dimensional) globular (gol-matol) proteins hain. Yeh polypeptide chains se bane hain jo apne aap par lipti (coiled) hoti hain. Globular enzyme molecule ki satah (surface) par ek chhota sa gaddha ya shigaf (cleft) hota hai jo sirf chand amino acids se bana hota hai. Is jagah ko active site kehte hain. Yahi woh jagah hai jahan catalysis (reaction ka tez hona) hota hai.

blocks.title: Ghalat jagah enzyme
blocks.text: Kuch enzymes ghalat jagah active ho jayen to nuqsan de sakte hain. Maslan pepsin protein hazam karne wala enzyme hai. Yeh us cell ke andar ki protein se bani cheezon ko tabah kar sakta hai jahan yeh banta hai. Isi liye yeh ghair-faal (inactive) shakal, pepsinogen, mein banta hai aur cell se bahar bheja jata hai. Jab yeh apne kaam ki jagah (maida) pohanchta hai to faal (active) ho kar pepsin ban jata hai.

Har enzyme ke active site ki shakal bohat khaas hoti hai, is liye us mein sirf ek khaas substrate molecule (jis par enzyme kaam karta hai) fit ho sakta hai. Active site teen-dimensional hai aur us par ek khaas charge hota hai. Active site ke do alag hisse hain: binding site aur catalytic site. Substrate molecule hydrogen bonds jaisi kamzor chemical quwwaton (weak forces) se binding site mein fit hota hai. Catalytic site reaction ko catalyse karta hai aur substrate products mein badal jata hai.

blocks.alt: Ek bara neela globular enzyme jis ki upar ki satah mein ek shigaf (cleft) hai. Gulabi substrate us shigaf mein fit hai. Shigaf ki deewarein hari hain (binding site) aur us ka farsh surkh hai (catalytic site); poora shigaf active site hai. Labels: Active site, Substrate, Binding site, Catalytic site, Enzyme.
blocks.caption: Enzyme ka active site: binding site aur catalytic site (hamara apna khaaka; kitab is jagah koi figure nahin chhapti).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Active site enzyme ki satah par chand amino acids ka chhota shigaf hai, jis ki shakal aur charge sirf ek makhsoos substrate se milte hain. Hari deewarein binding site hain: yeh substrate ko hydrogen bonds jaisi kamzor quwwaton se pakarti hain. Surkh farsh catalytic site hai: yeh substrate ke bonds par dabao dal kar use products mein badalta hai.

blocks.caption: Active site ke hisse

blocks.prompt: Proteins hazam karne wala enzyme ek aise cell ke andar mehfooz tareeqe se kyun ban sakta hai jo zyada tar proteins se bana hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh ghair-faal shakal (pepsinogen) mein banta hai jis ka active site kaam nahin karta, cell se bahar kharij hota hai, aur sirf wahan pohanch kar faal pepsin banta hai jahan us ki zaroorat hai.

items: Enzymes khaas proteins (biocatalysts) hain jo activation energy kam kar ke khaas reactions tez karte hain aur khud nahin badalte; raftar 10³ se 10⁸ guna tak barhti hai. Mukhtalif cells mein enzymes ke mukhtalif sets hain.
Enzymes ribosomes par bante hain; kuch cytoplasm mein (glycolysis), kuch organelles ki membranes se jure, kuch ribosomes ka hissa hain, aur kuch cell se bahar bheje jate hain (pepsinogen se pepsin).
Active site chand amino acids ka chhota khaas shigaf hai: binding site substrate ko kamzor bonds se pakarta hai aur catalytic site use products mein badalta hai.
